- `AgentSession` is thread-safe for state observation. It accepts one active Run; a concurrent prompt fails synchronously instead of being silently queued.
- `prompt` returns immediately with an `AgentRun`. `completion()` settles after the durable terminal transition. `abort()` is cooperative and idempotent.
- Provider and Tool effects execute off the Session commit boundary on bounded-by-caller/runtime executors. Store writes remain short revision-CAS critical sections.
- `Flow.Publisher` callbacks run on a Session-owned event executor so slow listeners cannot occupy Provider/Tool effect threads. Each subscriber buffer is bounded at 256 events; producers apply `SubmissionPublisher` backpressure instead of dropping lifecycle events or growing an unbounded queue. Listener failures are isolated by `SubmissionPublisher`.
- All public DTO collections are copied. `transcript()` and Store snapshots are immutable projections, never an alternate fact source.
